links.note: A certain judge is condensed to a judge.
Often expresses the repeated action of the imperfect.
Continual coming renders coming to the end.
Confidence in their righteousness condenses confidence in themselves that they are righteous.
Their babies renders the article with babies.
Belongs to such renders is of such.
Everything renders their own possessions; Greek has no separate word meaning all.
The dative marks the person concerned.
Rise again renders the resurrection sense of rise.
The verb ending supplies the speaker as subject.
For you and the connective are unexpressed.
